QuestInfo.name: Timber's Paw Stamp
QuestInfo.0: You need paw stamps from the townsfolk to become a true honorary fox. Visit Timber to take the first test.
QuestInfo.1: Timber says you should be able to eliminate 25 #o2400204#s and 25 #o2400205#s in 10 minutes. Defeat the monsters and get Timber's paw stamp.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the test and got Timber's paw stamp of approval.

0.0: Wow, you're taking the fox test already? I'm not sure how you'll do without ears or a tail. But hey, worth a try, right?
0.1: I want to see you take down #r#o2400204#s#k and #r#o2400205#s#k. Can you do #r25#k each in #b10 minutes#k? Any Pointy-Ear Fox can handle it.

yes.0: All right, #r25#k #r#o2400204#s#k and #r25#k #r#o2400205#s#k it is! You've got #b10 minutes#k, so don't dally. And don't think I'll go easy on you, either. I'm the only fox that has to hunt trees instead of food. I don't have sympathy for anyone.

no.0: Is 25 too many? Ha, too bad!

1.0: Done already? Wow, you brushed up on your hunting skills in a hurry. All those bugs you ate must've done you some good!

yes.0: Here you go, pal. The woodcutter fox says you're all right. But now you gotta impress #r#p3002006##k the teacher. He's a stiff one, so good luck. \r\n                                                                 #fUI/DialogImage.img/quest/0
